notes.title: 🏋️‍♂️MAJOR UPDATE coming a bit later 🏋️‍♀️
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey Gym Managers![/b]
[/h3][p]We previously announced that a MAJOR UPDATE for Gym Manager would drop on July 17th. However, as we work hard to polish every last detail, we’ve decided to push the release just a little - to J[b]uly 24th.[/b]
[/p][p]We know waiting can be tough, but we truly believe the extra time will help us deliver a much better experience. Thank you so much for your patience and support!
[/p][p]Here’s what you can expect in the upcoming update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed Level 12 requirements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed rotation of classic metal closet[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed issue with removing closet with bench[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved text placement[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved ratings performance[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added borderless display mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added requirements UI to the Bazaar[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Made minor localization improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted task completion logic[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Various other minor fixes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added global illumination[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved lighting[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added correct local lights[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added local specular reflections[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added particle effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved day/night cycle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved materials of environmental objects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added environmental objects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New translations will include: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Latin American Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hungarian, and Indonesian![/b]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for sticking with us - we can’t wait for you to try it out on July 24th! 💪[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🏋️‍♂️ MAJOR UPDATE IS COMING 🏋️‍♀️
notes.content:
[h3][b]July 17 - mark your calendars![/b][/h3][p]
A big update is on the way, bringing major improvements to visuals, lighting, performance, and UI. You can also expect a better day/night cycle, more environment details, and a bunch of bug fixes 🛠️[/p][p][/p][p]✨ Plus, we're expanding language support!
New translations will include: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Latin American Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hungarian, and Indonesian![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned - it’s going to be the biggest update yet! 💪[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon,
Gym Manager Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: NPC Update
notes.content:

The next update will NOT be in 2-3 weeks. We will prepare a bigger update and combine the next 4 updates in one. Have fun playing!

notes.title: Roadmap for Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798396/b4fb90d31d7d6e60a08055347cbde10d3bf34bee.png[/img]

[b]Dear Gym Managers![/b]

We’re excited to share our roadmap for the upcoming content updates! 
Here's what's coming:
[list]
[*] Achievements  
[*] 60 NPCs to interact with
[*] Selling old equipment at the Bazaar
[*] New Facilities & Workers: Sauna, Sweat Room, Massage Room, Solarium, Locker Room
[*] Third Floor expansion

This roadmap is built on your feedback. Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and shared their ideas. Your input is helping us make the game even better!

Best regards,
Gym Manager Team

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.content:
- Throwing boxes will no longer bug the game
- There was a slim to none chance that you would be able to get bugged item from lockpicking, that is fixed
- Bet prize and bet amount balanced
- Bet bugs fixed
- Member forgotten item dialogue stuck bug fixed
- Stuck customers bug fixed
- Level won't drop if you remove the old equipment but I suggest you don't remove them, because variety effects the membership fee
- Italian localization bugs fixed
- Sauna state resetting bug on save/load fixed
- Not removable decorations/equipment etc. fixed
- Equipment stealing quest will take into account older stolen equipment
- Guard shouldn't be stuck hitting the same customer
- Members will need more resting benches and won't sit at the same bench
- Supplements are more profitable

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
- Stuck quest bug
- Game not autosaving bug
- Italian localization bug

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Fixed/Changed:
-	Money will no longer be stuck under the ground
-	Money Stacks will always glow when not paying members are knocked down
-	French localization fixes
-	Illegal supplement Money is earned immediately when the item is sold
-	Guard will put stolen supplements to Player inventory if it has enough space
-	Fixed a bug with missing supplements
-	Slot machine takes less time to spin
-	Quests should no longer be stuck(Report if bug happens again)
-	Trash will no longer be stuck underground
-	Forgotten items will not be requested repeatedly by members
-	Supplements are less profitable
-	Illegal supplements are less profitable
-	Lockpickable doors balance changes

Working on:
-	Stuck customers
-	Not saved bets with “Daddy”
-	“Daddy” bets balance
-       A button for resetting game state to quickly fix bugs/glitches
